result: Minimizing a cubic-regularized Newton model at every step gives a monotone method that cannot be attracted by non-degenerate saddles, converges to second-order stationary points and drives ‖∇f‖ down like O(k^{−2/3}), faster than gradient descent’s O(k^{−1/2}).
result_plain: Cubic-regularized Newton: escapes strict saddles, reaches second-order points, O(k^-2/3) gradient rate.
